scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && node -e "const fs=require('node:fs');for(const f of ['ssh/internal/askpass.sh','snapshots/internal/backupkit-remote.sh']){fs.mkdirSync('dist/'+require('node:path').dirname(f),{recursive:true});fs.copyFileSync('src/'+f,'dist/'+f);}fs.chmodSync('dist/cli/main.js',0o755)"
scripts.push-and-publish: npm run build && git add -A && git commit -m 'Updates' && npm version patch && npm publish && git push -u origin main
scripts.docs: npm run build && npm --prefix docs run dev
scripts.docs:build: npm run build && npm --prefix docs run build
